lathe_connector: DB25 female on the side of the electrical cabinet behind the headstock (DTE: pin2 TxD, pin3 RxD)
shield: NOT connected to the connector shells
note: pin-to-pin 2-2/3-3 between DB9 and DB25 is a null-modem crossover. A standard 9-to-25 adapter (DB9 2->DB25 3) does NOT work (verified 2026-10-12: no data either way). Use a DB25 full-handshake null-modem adapter or this cable.
as_built_2026-10-13: User: the cable is exactly the manual p.61 version with the bridges on both ends (PC DB9 7-8 and 1-4-6, machine DB25 4-5 and 6-8-20). First CAM loads accepted by the control. With the PC-side bridges the PC's CTS/DSR/CD only echo its own RTS/DTR, so they say nothing about the lathe.
